name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with feet approximately shoulder-width apart and brace your trunk.
Bend at hips and knees to descend within a comfortable pain-free range.
Keep your whole foot in contact with the floor and knees moving in line with toes.
Stand tall by pushing through your feet.

name: Push-Up
steps: Begin in a high plank with hands near shoulder-width.
Lower under control while keeping body aligned.
Press the floor away to return to plank.

name: Supported Dumbbell Row
steps: Brace one hand on a stable support.
Keep back controlled, pull dumbbell toward hip.
